Nova Pryluka Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This is the companion record to Stara Pryluka's Jewish cemetery, documented elsewhere in this collection — the two towns split from a single settlement in the early 18th century, after which most Jewish communal life shifted here to Nova Pryluka, which grew to more than half the town's population by 1897. The community's fate was tied to its twin town even in death: after a single-street ghetto was liquidated in November 1941, about 2,500 of its inmates were murdered in Stara Pryluka.
